literal: Third month, day jisi: the empress performed the first silkworm rite at the northern suburb.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jisi day, the empress performed the first silkworm rite at the northern suburb.

literal: Day gengchen: Yangzhou defeated Xiao Yan's general at Yinshan and took the heads of his General of the Dragon Cavalry Wu Daoshuang and others, several thousand in all.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day Yangzhou defeated Xiao Yan's general at Yinshan and took the heads of his general of the dragon cavalry Wu Daoshuang and others, several thousand in all.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day guiwei, new moon: Bao Zhao was made General Who Guards the East and Military Inspector of East Yangzhou, enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang, state founding, Prince of Qi.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guiwei day, the new moon, Bao Zhao was made general who guards the east and military inspector of East Yangzhou, enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang, state founding, and Prince of Qi.

literal: Day gengyin: South Tianzhu presented a pratyeka-buddha tooth.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day South Tianzhu presented a pratyeka-buddha tooth.

literal: Day wuxu: an edict said: "Cruel officials bring calamity—a chronic ill since antiquity;
idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict said, "Cruel officials bring calamity—a chronic ill since antiquity;

literal: the filial wife and wanton punishment scorched the soil of Donghai.
idiomatic: the filial wife and wanton punishment scorched the soil of Donghai.

literal: Now rain has failed for ten ten-day periods—might there be wrongful imprisonments?
idiomatic: Now rain has failed for ten ten-day periods—might there be wrongful imprisonments?

literal: The Masters of Writing shall examine prisoners in the capital, striving to exhaust the principle of thorough hearing.
idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall examine prisoners in the capital, striving to exhaust the principle of thorough hearing.

literal: " Day jihai: because of drought the emperor reduced his meals and removed suspended music.
idiomatic: " On the jihai day, because of drought, the emperor reduced his meals and removed suspended music.

literal: Day xinchou: timely rain fell in great abundance.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day timely rain fell in great abundance.

literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: Yang Chun and Yang Zhi greatly defeated the rebel Di and took heads in the thousands.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day, Yang Chun and Yang Zhi greatly defeated the rebel Di and took heads in the thousands.

literal: Sixth month, day renwu, new moon: the emperor's younger brother Yue was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, the new moon, the emperor's younger brother Yue was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan.

literal: Day bingxu: from Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Ji provinces twenty thousand men and a thousand horses were levied and added to reinforce Shouchun.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day from Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Ji provinces twenty thousand men and a thousand horses were levied and added to reinforce Shouchun.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yimao: one of the Three Elders, Duke of Pingyang Pi, died.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yimao day, Pi, one of the Three Elders and Duke of Pingyang, died.

literal: Day gengwu: an edict restored collection of salt-pond profits to the public treasury.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day an edict restored collection of salt-pond profits to the public treasury.

literal: Day xinwei: Prince of Pengcheng Xie was made Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was made grand preceptor.

literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: Minister of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ying was made acting General Who Guards the South and attacked Xiao Yan's Yiyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengzi day, Yuan Ying, minister of the Masters of Writing, was made acting general who guards the south and attacked Xiao Yan's Yiyang.

literal: The state of Mohe presented hardwood arrows.
idiomatic: The state of Mohe presented hardwood arrows.

literal: Day xinchou: the court traveled to the detached palace at Henancheng.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day the court traveled to the detached palace at Henancheng.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day renzi: Yangzhou greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army, beheaded his Inspector of Xuzhou Pan Dianling, and captured Sima Mingsu.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the renzi day, Yangzhou greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army, beheaded his inspector of Xuzhou Pan Dianling, and captured Sima Mingsu.

literal: [7] Day jiwei: the heir of Wuxing, Yang Shaoxian, was made king of his state.
idiomatic: [7] On the jiwei day Yang Shaoxian, heir of Wuxing, was made king of his state.

literal: Day guihai: an edict ordered Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Huai to comfort and encourage the relocated capital and northern garrisons, relieving according to local conditions.
idiomatic: On the guihai day an edict ordered Yuan Huai, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to comfort and encourage the relocated capital and northern garrisons, relieving according to local conditions.

literal: Day yihai: General Who Guards the South Yuan Ying greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wu Ziyang at Baisha and captured and beheaded thousands.
idiomatic: On the yihai day Yuan Ying, general who guards the south, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wu Ziyang at Baisha and captured and beheaded thousands.

literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin: an edict ordered General Who Guards the South Li Chong to punish the rebel barbarians of East Jing.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengyin day, an edict ordered Li Chong, general who guards the south, to punish the rebel barbarians of East Jing.

literal: Day bingshen: an edict said: "The former court established models and standards so that all affairs might be fitting.
idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict said, "The former court established models and standards so that all affairs might be fitting.

literal: But years accumulate and people shift; sentiment turns slack and indolent.
idiomatic: But years accumulate and people shift; sentiment turns slack and indolent.

literal: Some presumptuously make additions and subtractions and let things fall into disuse without enforcement;
idiomatic: Some presumptuously make additions and subtractions and let things fall into disuse without enforcement;

literal: some cling to old survivals that no longer suit the time and at times cause harm;
idiomatic: some cling to old survivals that no longer suit the time and at times cause harm;

literal: some have duties confused and disorderly and push responsibility onto one another.
idiomatic: some have duties confused and disorderly and push responsibility onto one another.

literal: Let the hundred offices below list their doubts and gaps and report quickly to the throne.
idiomatic: Let the hundred offices below list their doubts and gaps and report quickly to the throne.

literal: " Day guimao: Xiao Yan's Acting Inspector of Liangzhou, Marquis of Pingyang county, state founding, Zhai Yuan, and Inspector of Xuzhou, Marquis of Yongchang county, state founding, Chen Huya, surrendered.
idiomatic: " On the guimao day Zhai Yuan, Xiao Yan's acting inspector of Liangzhou and Marquis of Pingyang county, state founding, and Chen Huya, inspector of Xuzhou and Marquis of Yongchang county, state founding, surrendered.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day xinmao: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, day dingwei, new moon: Grand Tutor, Prince of Beihai Xiang was degraded to commoner for his crime.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingwei day, the new moon, Xiang, grand tutor and Prince of Beihai, was degraded to commoner for his crime.

literal: Sixth month: because of drought music was withdrawn and meals reduced.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, because of drought, music was withdrawn and meals reduced.

literal: Day guisi: an edict said: "We, lacking in virtue, have many errors in government and punishments; yang drought has lasted ten ten-day periods; the capital districts are withered and parched—the blame rests on us, and we are guilty before dawn and dusk.
idiomatic: On the guisi day an edict said, "We, lacking in virtue, have many errors in government and punishments; yang drought has lasted ten ten-day periods; the capital districts are withered and parched—the blame rests on us, and we are guilty before dawn and dusk.

literal: The relevant offices may follow and examine the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—release and decide fairly;
idiomatic: The relevant offices may follow and examine the old canon and reverently carry out six measures: wrongful detention in prisons—release and decide fairly;

literal: common heads who neglect duty—measure and promote repair;
idiomatic: common heads who neglect duty—measure and promote repair;

literal: widowers and the solitary poor—wherever they are, preserve and relieve;
idiomatic: widowers and the solitary poor—wherever they are, preserve and relieve;

literal: corvée and tax burdens heavy and troublesome—all add waivers and reductions;
idiomatic: corvée and tax burdens heavy and troublesome—all add waivers and reductions;

literal: the worthy and upright who speak frankly—advance them with ritual; the greedy, cruel, flattering, and sycophantic—at times remove and dismiss them;
idiomatic: the worthy and upright who speak frankly—advance them with ritual; the greedy, cruel, flattering, and sycophantic—at times remove and dismiss them;

literal: men and women long separated in resentment—see that they are joined in marriage.
idiomatic: men and women long separated in resentment—see that they are joined in marriage.

literal: Thus answer our intent."
idiomatic: Thus answer our intent."

literal: Day jiawu: because of drought the emperor personally offered at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, because of drought, the emperor personally offered at the Grand Temple.

literal: Day wuxu: an edict established temples to the Duke of Zhou and to Boyi and Shuqi on Mount Shouyang.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict established temples to the Duke of Zhou and to Boyi and Shuqi on Mount Shouyang.

literal: Day gengzi: because of drought he received the dukes and ministers and below, taking blame upon himself.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, because of drought, he received the dukes and ministers and below, taking blame upon himself.

literal: He also reviewed prisoners in the capital; all below the death penalty were reduced one grade, and those liable to flogging and cudgeling were entirely pardoned.
idiomatic: He also reviewed prisoners in the capital; all below the death penalty were reduced one grade, and those liable to flogging and cudgeling were entirely pardoned.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guichou: Jiaocheng Garrison Commander under Xiao Yan, Chai Qingzong, brought the city to surrender.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, Chai Qingzong, Jiaocheng garrison commander under Xiao Yan, brought the city to surrender.

literal: Li Chong greatly defeated the barbarian chieftain Fan Su'an.
idiomatic: Li Chong greatly defeated the barbarian chieftain Fan Su'an.

literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.

literal: An edict: the Prefect of Luoyang, on great affairs, may be heard in personal memorial at court.
idiomatic: An edict allowed the prefect of Luoyang, on great affairs, to be heard in personal memorial at court.

literal: Day yiyou: Yuan Ying attacked Yiyang, took it, and sent captive Xiao Yan's General Who Champions Cai Ling'en and more than ten generals.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yuan Ying attacked Yiyang, took it, and sent captive Cai Ling'en, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and more than ten generals.

literal: Day xinmao: Ying again greatly defeated Yan's generals and cleared the three passes.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day Ying again greatly defeated Yan's generals and cleared the three passes.

literal: Day dingyou: Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan.

literal: Day wuxu: the western Qiang Song Wan led four thousand households inward in submission.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day the western Qiang Song Wan led four thousand households inward in submission.

literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: an edict ordered garrisons north and south along the Huai, all to sow wheat by autumn and plant millet and rice in spring, according to local suitability using both land and water, so that the land yields without waste and troops without surplus strength—by the coming harvest both public and private may be aided alike.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingwu day, an edict ordered garrisons north and south along the Huai to sow wheat by autumn and plant millet and rice in spring according to local suitability, using both land and water, so that the land yields without waste and troops without surplus strength—by the coming harvest both public and private may be aided alike.

literal: Another edict ordered all provinces to suspend corvée levies and not presumptuously impose extra collections.
idiomatic: Another edict ordered all provinces to suspend corvée levies and not presumptuously impose extra collections.

literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered that Cai Ling'en and others, Xiao Yan's general who champions and acting overseer of Si province, whom Prince of Zhongshan Ying had captured, be promoted according to talent; day yichou: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Huo province Tian Daolong and Inspector of Yi province Zhang Zongzhi sent envoys inward in submission.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day an edict ordered that Cai Ling'en and others, Xiao Yan's general who champions and acting overseer of Si province, whom Prince of Zhongshan Ying had captured, be promoted according to talent; on the yichou day Tian Daolong, Xiao Yan's inspector of Huo province, and Zhang Zongzhi, inspector of Yi province, sent envoys inward in submission.

literal: The Rouran raided the frontier; an edict ordered Left Vice Director Yuan Huai to punish them.
idiomatic: The Rouran raided the frontier; an edict ordered Yuan Huai, left vice director, to punish them.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day yiwei: an edict forbade officials in plain dress from recruiting clerks.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiwei day, an edict forbade officials in plain dress from recruiting clerks.

literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: an edict said: "The sage kings of old, founding enterprise and handing down succession, settling the people and establishing transformation, all honored the glue-and-lin academies, opened instruction for the imperial scions, made bright the three rites, and exalted the four arts, so that the Way pervaded the myriad states and influence flowed to the ten thousand realms.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuwu day, an edict said, "The sage kings of old, founding enterprise and handing down succession, settling the people and establishing transformation, all honored the glue-and-lin academies, opened instruction for the imperial scions, made bright the three rites, and exalted the four arts, so that the Way pervaded the myriad states and influence flowed to the ten thousand realms.

literal: Since the imperial foundation moved and was re-established in the central region, military and state affairs have been pressing and the classics could not yet be built—reflecting on this, we are ashamed before the ancient exemplars.
idiomatic: Since the imperial foundation moved and was re-established in the central region, military and state affairs have been pressing and the classics could not yet be built—reflecting on this, we are ashamed before the ancient exemplars.

literal: Let the relevant offices, following Han and Wei old statutes, repair and build the National University.
idiomatic: Let the relevant offices, following Han and Wei old statutes, repair and build the National University.

literal: " Twelfth month, day bingzi: park and pasture public fields were divided and given to households of the relocated capital.
idiomatic: " In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, park and pasture public fields were divided and given to households of the relocated capital.

literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered the assembled ministers to deliberate on fixing laws and ordinances.
idiomatic: On the jimao day an edict ordered the assembled ministers to deliberate on fixing laws and ordinances.

literal: Day jihai: the court traveled to Yique.
idiomatic: On the jihai day the court traveled to Yique.

literal: Intercalary month, day guimao, new moon: Xiahou Daqian, Xiao Yan's acting inspector of Liangzhou, held Hanzhong and came to surrender; Acting Master of Writing Xing Luan was made acting General Who Pacifies the West and led troops to go to him.
idiomatic: On the guimao day of the intercalary month, the new moon, Xiahou Daqian, Xiao Yan's acting inspector of Liangzhou, held Hanzhong and came to surrender; Xing Luan, acting master of writing, was made acting general who pacifies the west and led troops to go to him.

literal: Day yichou: General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Minister of Works; Master of Writing, Prince of Guangyang Jia was given equipage equal to the Three Directors.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Yong, general of agile cavalry and Prince of Gaoyang, was made minister of works; Jia, master of writing and Prince of Guangyang, was given equipage equal to the Three Directors.

literal: Second year, spring, first month, day bingzi: the heir of Dangchang, Liang Mibo, was made king of his state.
idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the bingzi day, Liang Mibo, heir of Dangchang, was made king of his state.

literal: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month: the Di of Liangzhou rebelled and cut the Hanzhong supply route.
idiomatic: In the second month the Di of Liangzhou rebelled and cut the Hanzhong supply route.

literal: Inspector Xing Luan repeatedly greatly defeated them.
idiomatic: Inspector Xing Luan repeatedly greatly defeated them.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiwei: Prince of Chengyang Luan died.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiwei day, Luan, Prince of Chengyang, died.

literal: Day yichou: an edict said: "Appointing the worthy to illumine government is a constant rule since old; proclaiming influence and aiding affairs truly depends on many officers.
idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict said, "Appointing the worthy to illumine government is a constant rule since old; proclaiming influence and aiding affairs truly depends on many officers.

literal: Yet what the Rectifiers select preserves only family status; the Masters of Writing in their ordering still do not raise men for talent.
idiomatic: Yet what the Rectifiers select preserves only family status; the Masters of Writing in their ordering still do not raise men for talent.

literal: Thus outstanding virtue rarely rises and office affairs are much delayed.
idiomatic: Thus outstanding virtue rarely rises and office affairs are much delayed.

literal: If the selection is not refined, how shall promotion be examined?
idiomatic: If the selection is not refined, how shall promotion be examined?

literal: The Eight Seats shall deliberate the methods of former ages for presenting scholars and the forms for elevating the worthy, so that talent and learning are both displayed and qualification and standing both attained.
idiomatic: The Eight Seats shall deliberate the methods of former ages for presenting scholars and the forms for elevating the worthy, so that talent and learning are both displayed and qualification and standing both attained.

literal: " Day bingyin: because the Di of Chouchi rebelled, an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendor Yang Chun, acting General Who Pacifies the West, to lead troops to punish them.
idiomatic: " On the bingyin day, because the Di of Chouchi rebelled, an edict ordered Yang Chun, grand master of splendor and acting general who pacifies the west, to lead troops to punish them.

literal: Xing Luan sent Commander Wang Zu on a western campaign and repeatedly defeated Xiao Yan's armies, entered Jianmen Pass, and sent captive Xiao Yan's General Who Assists the State Fan Shinan to the capital.
idiomatic: Xing Luan sent Commander Wang Zu on a western campaign and repeatedly defeated Xiao Yan's armies, entered Jianmen Pass, and sent captive Fan Shinan, Xiao Yan's general who assists the state, to the capital.

literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: the Di bandit □ Hu led his hosts to surrender.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, the Di bandit Hu led his hosts to surrender.

literal: Sixth month, day jichou: an edict said: "Meritorious ministers of the former court—some personally suffered punishment and demotion, and their descendants sank into obscurity;
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, an edict said, "Meritorious ministers of the former court—some personally suffered punishment and demotion, and their descendants sank into obscurity;

literal: some lost proper sequence on the official path and fell from the old stream—because of this they were not selected; how shall encouragement be offered?
idiomatic: some lost proper sequence on the official path and fell from the old stream—because of this they were not selected; how shall encouragement be offered?

literal: Speaking of former achievement, feeling has its near and far.
idiomatic: Speaking of former achievement, feeling has its near and far.

literal: Among the clan and common kindred, where the achievements of grandfather, great-grandfather, and father can be recorded yet there is no court office—or there is office and talent suffices for exceptional promotion—let appointment follow talent."
idiomatic: Among the clan and common kindred, where the achievements of grandfather, great-grandfather, and father can be recorded yet there is no court office—or there is office and talent suffices for exceptional promotion—let appointment follow talent."

literal: Day jiayin: Xiao Yan's general who champions Li Tian and others set camp east of Shiping commandery, [9] north of the Fu River.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day Li Tian, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and others set camp east of Shiping commandery, [9] north of the Fu River.

literal: Wang Zu met and defeated them, beheading Xiao Yan's general who champions Zhang Tang, general who assists the state Ma Shi, general who calms the north Li Dang and Jiang Jianzu, general who assists the state Feng Wenhao, general of the dragon cavalry He Yingzhi, and others.
idiomatic: Wang Zu met and defeated them, beheading Zhang Tang, Xiao Yan's general who champions, Ma Shi, general who assists the state, Li Dang and Jiang Jianzu, generals who calm the north, Feng Wenhao, general who assists the state, He Yingzhi, general of the dragon cavalry, and others.

literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered Master of Writing Li Chong, Minister of the Imperial Treasury Yu Zhong, Regular Attendant You Zhao, and Remonstrator and Critic Deng Xian—Chong and Zhong with staffs of authority and additionally palace attendants, Xian additionally Yellow Gate—all as great envoys to investigate and decide within the outer provinces and inside the capital districts; where prefects, magistrates, and the like had exposed faults and losses, they were at once to execute judgment; for weighty posts in provinces and garrisons, memorials were permitted.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day an edict ordered Li Chong, master of writing, Yu Zhong, minister of the imperial treasury, You Zhao, regular attendant, and Deng Xian, remonstrator and critic—Chong and Zhong with staffs of authority and additionally palace attendants, Xian additionally yellow gate—all as great envoys to investigate and decide within the outer provinces and inside the capital districts; where prefects, magistrates, and the like had exposed faults and losses, they were at once to execute judgment; for weighty posts in provinces and garrisons, memorials were permitted.

literal: Day yichou: Xiao Yan's general who champions Wang Jingyin and general who assists the state Lu Fangda and others attacked Zhuting; Wang Zu greatly defeated them and beheaded his general who assists the state Wang Mingda and general of the dragon cavalry Zhang Fangchi.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Wang Jingyin, Xiao Yan's general who champions, Lu Fangda, general who assists the state, and others attacked Zhuting; Wang Zu greatly defeated them and beheaded Wang Mingda, general who assists the state, and Zhang Fangchi, general of the dragon cavalry.

literal: Day dingmao: Military Inspector of Yangzhou Xue Zhendu greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wang Chaozong and captured and beheaded three thousand.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day Xue Zhendu, military inspector of Yangzhou, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wang Chaozong and captured and beheaded three thousand.

literal: Day wuchen: Xiao Yan's general Lu Fangda garrisoned and defended Xincheng; Zu again sent Commander Lu Zuqian and others to defeat them and beheaded Xiao Yan's general who champions Yang Boren and general who calms the north Ren Anding.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day Lu Fangda, Xiao Yan's general, garrisoned and defended Xincheng; Zu again sent Lu Zuqian, commander, and others to defeat them and beheaded Yang Boren, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and Ren Anding, general who calms the north.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiaxu: an edict said: "We have inherited and steered the imperial succession; for seven years now virtue has not spread abroad and the mirror does not illumine far—people's wrongs and suffering still flourish wherever one looks, yet the prisons of investigation do not flow freely below, worthy and foolish are not distinguished, black and white run together—this is not how to renew the people's eyes and ears and make good and evil stir the heart.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, an edict said, "We have inherited and steered the imperial succession; for seven years now virtue has not spread abroad and the mirror does not illumine far—people's wrongs and suffering still flourish wherever one looks, yet the prisons of investigation do not flow freely below, worthy and foolish are not distinguished, black and white run together—this is not how to renew the people's eyes and ears and make good and evil stir the heart.

literal: Now great envoys are dispatched separately to inspect provinces, touring and examining; wherever fault and burden match local reputation, add investigation and dismissal at once, to display the thunder's majesty and extend the bannered carriage's action—thereby observing customs and distinguishing practices, gathering reports of merit and fault, rewarding the worthy, punishing the licentious and wicked, exhausting reason and relieving distress, to answer our heart."
idiomatic: Now great envoys are dispatched separately to inspect provinces, touring and examining; wherever fault and burden match local reputation, add investigation and dismissal at once, to display the thunder's majesty and extend the bannered carriage's action—thereby observing customs and distinguishing practices, gathering reports of merit and fault, rewarding the worthy, punishing the licentious and wicked, exhausting reason and relieving distress, to answer our heart."

literal: Day wuzi: Wang Zu defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded his general of the dragon cavalry Yu Zenghui, general who calms the north Ku Baoshou, general who assists the state Lu Tianhui, and general who establishes martial prowess Wang Wenbiao.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day Wang Zu defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded Yu Zenghui, general of the dragon cavalry, Ku Baoshou, general who calms the north, Lu Tianhui, general who assists the state, and Wang Wenbiao, general who establishes martial prowess.

literal: Wang Zu pressed Fucheng; day renchen: Xiao Yan's Administrator of Baxi, Yu Yu, general who champions and army commander Li Tian and others met in battle; Zu defeated them and captured and beheaded thousands.
idiomatic: Wang Zu pressed Fucheng; on the renchen day Yu Yu, Xiao Yan's administrator of Baxi, Li Tian, general who champions and army commander, and others met in battle; Zu defeated them and captured and beheaded thousands.

literal: Eighth month, day renyin: an edict ordered Prince of Zhongshan Ying on a southern campaign against Xiang and Mian.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renyin day, an edict ordered Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, on a southern campaign against Xiang and Mian.

literal: Day gengxu: Wang Zu sent Commanders Ji Hongya and Lu Zuqian and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded his Inspectors of Qin and Liang provinces Lu Fangda and fourteen others.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day Wang Zu sent Ji Hongya and Lu Zuqian, commanders, and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded Lu Fangda, Xiao Yan's inspectors of Qin and Liang provinces, and fourteen others.

literal: Day renzi: Wang Zu again sent Commander Lu Zuqian and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded his Area Commander, general who champions, Marquis of Zitong county, state founding, Wang Jingyin, Liu Da, and twenty-four generals.
idiomatic: On the renzi day Wang Zu again sent Lu Zuqian, commander, and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded Wang Jingyin, area commander, general who champions, and Marquis of Zitong county, state founding, Liu Da, and twenty-four generals.

literal: Day jiayin: Yangzhou attacked Xiao Yan's general Jiang Qingzhen at Yangshi and defeated him.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yangzhou attacked Jiang Qingzhen, Xiao Yan's general, at Yangshi and defeated him.
